customManagers.description: Keep the node base image literal in uninstall.sh and the README in sync with the Dockerfile
Keep the digest-pinned DIND sidecar image literal in the launcher current

packageRules.description: Bump the node base image everywhere in one PR
Pin yq's image digest (the Dockerfile COPYs the binary out of it); Renovate updates tag and digest together
Pin the digests of the docker CLI and DIND sidecar images

Merge updates of the tooling images (docker CLI, DIND sidecar, node base image, yq), majors included, once the required stub-tests and integration-tests checks pass; the integration tests are what vouches for them. No minimumReleaseAge: Renovate has no release timestamps for these docker updates, and with timestamp-required it would hold them back forever
Merge GitHub Actions updates once the required stub-tests check passes, but not before a release is 3 days old; main only accepts squash merges
